gas.basis: RECS 2020 CE4.3, Midwest, main heating fuel = natural gas

oil.basis: RECS 2020 CE4.2, Northeast, main heating fuel = fuel oil or kerosene

electric.basis: RECS 2020 CE4.3, Midwest, main heating fuel = electricity
RECS 2020 CE4.5, West, main heating fuel = electricity

gas.basis: RECS 2020 CE4.5, West, main heating fuel = natural gas

source: EIA RECS 2020 Table CE4.x (annual household site end-use consumption by fuel; revised March 2024), by Census region and main heating fuel: CE4.2 Northeast, CE4.3 Midwest, CE4.5 West. Space heating includes main and secondary heating; 'other' = refrigerators + other end uses. RECS publishes no climate-zone x heating-fuel cross, so zone 5A uses Midwest (gas, electric) and Northeast (oil) and zone 2B uses the West region; hot-climate cooling shares for 2B are therefore likely understated. See the 'basis' field on each entry.
